✨ Join us at The Gathered Room for a joyful celebration of Diwali, with beautiful henna artistry, Bollywood tunes & South Asian treats

About this Event

✨ A little color, a little culture, and a whole lot of Diwali magic! 🪔
Join us at The Gathered Room for a joyful celebration of Diwali, the Festival of Lights!
We're bringing the festive spirit to TGR with beautiful henna artistry, Bollywood tunes, South Asian treats, and plenty of colorful cheer!
🌸 Henna by Heartful Henna | 2–4 PM
We're delighted to welcome Praveena Padakala of Heartful Henna, a certified henna artist with over seven years of experience. Praveena creates beautiful, intricate, personalized designs using her own homemade, natural, organic henna paste.
Stop by, choose a design, and treat yourself to a little henna magic!
🪔 Diwali Magic All Day Long | 10 AM–5 PM
The festivities don't stop with henna! Enjoy Bollywood music, festive treats, and a warm, colorful atmosphere as you explore our thoughtfully curated collection of handcrafted, artisan, and vintage treasures.
Whether you're celebrating Diwali or simply curious to experience its beauty and traditions, everyone is welcome!
📅 Saturday, November 7
🛍️ Store Open: 10 AM–5 PM
🌸 Henna Artist: 2–4 PM
📍 The Gathered Room | 505 Main Street, Medfield, MA
✨ Come celebrate the Festival of Lights with us—shop, explore, and soak up a little Diwali magic!
All are welcome! ❤️
